verdict.rationale: Docs state the agent writes tests as part of implementing features and can run code/install dependencies/test changes in isolated environments, and a PR-review flow checks test coverage before flagging issues — together implying self-validation via generated tests. However, there is no explicit end-to-end walkthrough showing the agent generating tests, running them, and iterating/fixing before proposing a PR, nor independent/hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: explicit documented workflow tying test generation+execution to pre-PR validation, independent corroboration of this loop working in practice.
